        self.max_workers = max_workers
        self.active_workers: Dict[int, float] = {}  # {thread_id: last_heartbeat}
        self.lock = threading.RLock()
        self._watchdog_thread = threading.Thread(target=self._monitor, daemon=True)
        self._watchdog_thread.start()

    def _monitor(self):
        while True:
            time.sleep(5)  # Check every 5 seconds
            with self.lock:
                now = time.time()
                stuck_workers = [
                    tid for tid, last_beat in self.active_workers.items()
                    if now - last_beat > 30  # 30s timeout
                ]
                for tid in stuck_workers:
                    self._kill_worker(tid)

    def _kill_worker(self, thread_id: int):

        # For now, log and remove from tracking
        del self.active_workers[thread_id]
        print(f"[WATCHDOG] Killed stuck worker {thread_id}")

    def register_worker(self):
        with self.lock:
            if len(self.active_workers) >= self.max_workers:
                raise RuntimeError("Max workers reached")
            thread_id = threading.get_ident()
            self.active_workers[thread_id] = time.time()

    def heartbeat(self):
        with self.lock:
            thread_id = threading.get_ident()
            if thread_id in self.active_workers:
                self.active_workers[thread_id] = time.time()

    def unregister_worker(self):
        with self.lock:
            thread_id = threading.get_ident()
            self.active_workers.pop(thread_id, None)

    def decorator(func):
